The '''''Soaring Duros''''' was a [[Hover barge/Legends|hoverbarge]] used by the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]] a group of individuals hired by exiled Ravagers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ruugar]] boarded the vessel while it was docked in [[Coratanni Town]]. Aboard they faced and defeated the Chief Engineer [[Torque (pirate)|Torque]], who was defending engine room. After the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was killed, Ruugar took the ship to the skies and announced to the crew that he has returned as their captain. As the ''Soaring Duros'' approached [[Coratanni]]'s flagship ''[[Pearl's Girl]]'', the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[Blaster (droid)|Blaster]] and his maker [[BO-55|Master]] were send to stop the invaders, but they failed and were destroyed. Ruugar's team then took a shuttle from the ''Soaring Duros'' to ''Pearl's Girl'', where they killed both Coratanni and Ruugar, after he decided to backstab them instead of honoring their deal.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Soaring Duros'' appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
